# VS Code / Copilot repository adapter

The canonical, IDE-agnostic instructions for this repository are in the root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Read and follow that file before making changes.

Task workflows live in [`.agents/skills/`](../.agents/skills/). `AGENTS.md` routes ordinary requests to them. Claude Code also discovers thin adapters in [`.claude/skills/`](../.claude/skills/). Do not claim parallel agent work unless the host actually performed it.
